import inspect

import solution
from solution import cube_Sum


def test_issue_example_n2():
    """Example assert cube_Sum(2) == 72."""
    assert cube_Sum(2) == 72  # 2^3 + 4^3 = 8 + 64 = 72


def test_issue_first_one():
    """Cube sum of first 1 even natural number is 2 cubed."""
    assert cube_Sum(1) == 8  # 2^3 = 8


def test_issue_first_three():
    """Cube sum of first 3 even natural numbers."""
    assert cube_Sum(3) == 288  # 8 + 64 + 216 = 288


def test_issue_first_four():
    """Cube sum of first 4 even natural numbers."""
    assert cube_Sum(4) == 800  # 8 + 64 + 216 + 512 = 800


def test_issue_first_five():
    """Cube sum of first 5 even natural numbers."""
    assert cube_Sum(5) == 1800  # 800 + 1000 = 1800 since 10^3 = 1000


def test_issue_zero_empty():
    """Cube sum of first 0 even natural numbers is empty sum."""
    assert cube_Sum(0) == 0  # empty sum = 0


def test_issue_first_six():
    """Cube sum of first 6 even natural numbers."""
    assert cube_Sum(6) == 3528  # 1800 + 1728 = 3528 since 12^3 = 1728


def test_issue_first_ten():
    """Cube sum of first 10 even natural numbers."""
    assert cube_Sum(10) == 24200  # 2*10^2*11^2 = 2*100*121 = 24200


def test_contract_has_cube_sum():
    """Module `solution` provides `cube_Sum`."""
    assert callable(solution.cube_Sum)


def test_contract_takes_single_argument():
    """Public interface `def cube_Sum(n)` takes one argument n."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(cube_Sum).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Example `assert cube_Sum(2) == 72` implies integer result."""
    assert isinstance(cube_Sum(2), int)
